info.name: CashFlow Banking Platform — Full Route Testing
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the CashFlow Banking Platform (Next.js App Router).

## Structure
- **01 Server API Routes** — every backend route under `/app/api/*` (auth, users, accounts, banks, transactions, plaid, monitoring)
- **02 Frontend Page Routes** — every server-rendered page under `/app/(auth)` and `/app/(root)`

## Quick Start
1. Run the dev server: `npm run dev`
2. Import this file into Postman (**Import → postman.json**)
3. Requests marked ✅ **Demo** work instantly with zero configuration (mock test user `test-user-demo`)
4. Requests marked ⚠️ **Live** require `.env` credentials (Appwrite / Plaid / Dwolla) and/or a session cookie

## Test User (mock data, no services needed)
- userId: `test-user-demo`
- Bank item ids: `mock-bank-1`, `mock-bank-2`, `mock-bank-3`
- 3 banks, 10 transactions, fully paginated

Generated for route-level smoke testing. Every request carries `pm.test` assertions.

item.name: 02 Frontend Page Routes
item.description:
Server-rendered pages (Next.js App Router). These verify each route compiles and responds with HTML.

- `/sign-in` and `/sign-up` are public.
- `/`, `/my-banks`, `/transaction-history`, `/payment-transfer` are **protected** — without a session cookie they render an empty shell (HTTP 200, blank content by design; see `app/(root)/page.tsx` → `if (!loggedIn) return;`).
- To test protected pages with real data: sign in in the browser, copy the `appwrite-session` cookie, and add it under the collection's **Cookies** manager (or as a `Cookie` header).

request.description: `app/(root)/page.tsx` — total balance box, recent transactions, right sidebar. Supports `?id=<appwriteItemId>&page=<n>`.
`app/(auth)/sign-in/page.tsx` — renders `AuthForm type="sign-in"`.
`app/(auth)/sign-up/page.tsx` — renders `AuthForm type="sign-up"`.
`app/(root)/my-banks/page.tsx` — list of connected banks + PlaidLink.
`app/(root)/transaction-history/page.tsx` — per-bank history with pagination.
`app/(root)/payment-transfer/page.tsx` — Dwolla-funded transfer form.
